title: Content Writer
summary: A content writer writes the words on a brand's website, blog, newsletters and articles, often tuned for search engines (SEO) so people find them on Google. The role sits in a marketing team or content agency and works from briefs given by an editor, client or marketing manager.
dailyDuties: Research topics and keywords for upcoming articles
Write blogs, website pages and newsletters from briefs
Edit and proofread drafts against the style guide
Add meta titles, headings and internal links for SEO
Publish and format posts in WordPress or another CMS
Revise drafts after feedback from editors or clients

skills.expectation: Write blogs, website pages, articles and newsletters in a brand's voice
Do keyword research and write SEO-optimised articles that rank
Apply on-page SEO basics such as meta titles, headings and internal links
Edit and proofread own and others' drafts against a style guide
Turn topics into briefs and outlines and keep to an editorial calendar
Format and publish posts in WordPress or another CMS
Take briefs from clients or product teams and handle feedback rounds
Check page traffic and rankings in Google Analytics or Search Console
Write email newsletters and campaign copy
Adapt articles into social media posts
Research audiences and competitors before writing

certifications.why: Free course covering keyword research and on-page SEO used in SEO writing
Free course on inbound content strategy that many content teams follow
